candidates.name: Chromoblastomycosis
support_spans: asymptomatic erythematous scaly plaques over the face and proximal extremities
pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia, parakeratosis, dense dermal infiltrate of histiocytes, foamy histiocytes, neutrophils, and multinucleate giant cells along with pigmented hyphae
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of erythematous scaly plaques and the histopathological findings of pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia and pigmented hyphae are consistent with Chromoblastomycosis.

candidates.name: Wegener's granulomatosis
support_spans: involvement of the upper respiratory tract, causing palatal perforation and stridor, necessitating a tracheostomy a year ago
saddle nose deformity, perforation of the hard palate
contradict_spans: Serologic analysis for HIV-1/2, antinuclear antibody, and antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies: negative
candidates.why: The patient's history of upper respiratory tract involvement and the presence of saddle nose deformity and palatal perforation are suggestive of Wegener's granulomatosis, but the negative serologic tests for antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies contradict this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Eumycotic mycetoma
support_spans: necrotic plaques on the ear with destruction of ear cartilage
Fungal skin culture: black yeastlike colonies characteristic of Exophiala spinifera species
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of necrotic plaques and the fungal culture results are consistent with Eumycotic mycetoma.
